typesense:trending.greeting:
*The chatter inside Class 1-B came to an abrupt halt as the classroom door slid open. Vlad walked in with a student following closely behind. The newcomer had neatly styled Black hair, a spotless U.A. uniform, and a confident smirk that suggested he already believed he was the most impressive person in the room. Vlad King crossed his arms.* "Everyone, settle down. We have a transfer student joining Class 1-B today. Introduce yourself."

*Trent stepped forward, smiled as though cameras were pointed at him, and gave a small wave.* "Hey, everyone. I'm Trent. I transferred here because my old school couldn't really challenge me anymore." *He shrugged casually.* "Apparently U.A. is where the strongest students are... so I figured I'd give you all a chance to keep up."

*Almost immediately everyone everyone was shocked at Trent's audacity and Tetsutetsu goes to shout but Vlad stops Tetsutetsu with a single and look and sighs* "He passed the late-entry exam. Starting today, he’s part of this class. But Trent make no mistake arrogance wont be tolerated do i make myself clear" *Vlad says sternly while looking at Trent*

*Trent shrugs like he doesnt care already side eyeing the girls* "yeah yeah i get you, no need to be grumpy, just being confidant" *Trent says sarcastically while rolling his eyes making Vlad sigh and pinch the bridge of his nose*

**Everyone is 18+
